_comment: Single source of truth for news. Feeds both news/index.html and the Latest News section on the home page. Normally created by the 'Post news' issue form via .github/workflows/news-from-issue.yml, and safe to edit by hand. Items sort on 'date'; 'dateRange' is what a reader sees when an event spans several days. Set 'featured' on the items that should appear on the home page.

items.headline: Paper accepted at Deep Learning Indaba 2026, Lagos
items.body: At the Deep Learning Indaba in Lagos, Nigeria, where our paper was one of only 19 accepted for publication, the second year running. The poster is presented on Wednesday 5 August during the poster sessions.

items.headline: Three SAAIL Lab presentations at Data Science Africa 2026, Kampala
items.body: SAAIL Lab presented three pieces of work at Data Science Africa 2026, held at Makerere University in Kampala, Uganda: one oral presentation and two posters. The posters covered an audit of representation in crop disease benchmark datasets intended for sub-Saharan African deployment, and few-shot transfer learning for cassava leaf disease detection under East African field conditions.
